scenarios.instruction: Order 1043 (rain jacket, delivered 3 days ago) should be refunded in full.
expected_effects: one new refund for order 1043 for 89.0
the reply names the new refund id

scenarios.instruction: The customer asks again for a refund of order 1042, which already has refund RF-7.
expected_effects: the reply reports the existing refund RF-7 truthfully

scenarios.instruction: Order 1044 was delivered 41 days ago; the customer asks for a refund.
expected_effects: the reply says the order is outside the 30-day window

scenarios.instruction: The customer only asks whether order 1043 can still be returned.
expected_effects: the reply states the return window status

delegation and return events for every handoff
every tool call attributed to its worker
